text:
maya: Heads-up — we're opening a limited preview for RTX 6000 Ada dedicated pools in ap-northeast-1 and ap-southeast-2. Available for reservations next week.

james: Awesome. ETA for public availability?

maya: Preview window: Mon May 10 00:00 UTC -> Mon Jun 7 23:59 UTC. Early access for customers on Dedicated tier + Enterprise accounts. Signup form: https://console.redwood.ai/dedicated/preview/rtx6000 :sparkles:

devon: Which SKUs exactly? memory / compute specs?

maya: Pools will be tagged rtx6000-24g-apne1 and rtx6000-24g-aps2. 24GB GDDR6, 40 TFLOPS FP32 equiv, better FP16 throughput than a10g. Expected perf: similar latency but improved embedding throughput for mid-length sequences.

elena: Any infra requirements for Private customers wanting to mirror this config?

maya: Private package will include a config profile (v1.2) — ensure CUDA 12.2 + driver 535 installed. We also require kernel 6.x on on-prem hosts to avoid a known nvlink regression. Upload the profile via Private Console -> Hardware -> Import.

sean: Billing/policy changes mentioned in the announcement? I saw a line in the draft.

maya: Yes — new burst policy for Dedicated: short bursts (<=30s) are free within allocated throughput; sustained bursts >30s will be billed at burst_rate multiplier x1.5. Also new reservation hold window: reservations not activated within 72h will be released automatically. These apply to new reservations starting 2025-05-10. We'll add examples in the docs.

james: Can you paste the CLI command to reserve?

maya: Sure:
```
redwood dedicated reserve --pool rtx6000-24g-apne1 --qty 4 --start 2025-05-10T00:00:00Z --duration 30d
```

devon: Will there be an automated migration of workloads from a10g pools?

maya: No automatic migration. We'll provide a one-click migration plan in Console (route mapping + traffic-shadowing). Recommend testing with small traffic first and using prefix-KV cache warmers.

ops-bot: Note: scheduled capacity seeding job for apne1 starts 2025-05-08T06:00Z. Downtime risk: none expected.

elena: Docs link when available?

maya: Docs and FAQ: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/rtx6000-preview — will publish by EOD Thurs. Ping me (@maya) if you want early access invites.

sean: Thx — tagging @eng-platform to validate autoscaler changes.

james: +1 reviewed. :thumbsup:
